quote:
The earth hears the clack of missiles yet sighs only for the breath of those it shelters.  

When a plague heals, the village learns that restoration is a shared miracle beyond one shepherd's blessing.  

A dead whale pulled onto shore turns a quiet drum into a wakeful song, for the ocean remembers every heartbeat.  

A bus reborn after years of silence reminds that the road sweeps forward only when the rider chooses to stride.  

If a vote cannot be read by all, the people's voice becomes a paper boat that some cannot lift onto the current.  

When the roar of fans turns to a storm, one must remember that celebration is a path that never barges through the sanctity of the crowd.  

When a forbidden vessel is seized with calm resolve, giants feel the weight of mercy even upon the tides of power.
